high_level_description: The image is a product listing for "Orion Turtle Chips - Spicy Devil Korean corn chips." The packaging is prominently displayed at the top of the image. The bag is black with red and orange flames as part of its design, giving it a spicy and fiery appearance. The brand name "Orion" is written at the top left corner of the bag, and the product name "Turtle Chips" is written in bold white letters. Below the product name, there's a tagline that reads "Spicy Devil Corn Chip," accompanied by an illustration of a devil character holding a piece of food, which adds to the spicy theme
